wall.why_finite_fails: Three independent, in-house-certified refutations of finite approach: (a) Euler-factor sections have zeros UNIFORMLY at Im x = 1/2 for every prime and every rung — kernel negative control MM_euler_factor_section_offline via twoFreq_realRooted_iff, since ||1|| != p^{-1/2} always; truncated products are zero-free entirely; (b) partial sums of zeta have zeros with Re s > 1 for all large N (Turan hope killed by Montgomery 1983); (c) the un-graded classification trap — certifying even one defect-0 member of the arithmetic class is equivalent to proving that member's GRH, so no finite exhibit exists. wall.name: The uniform tail: all-n Li positivity / all-support Weil positivity
wall.form: ∀ n ≥ 1, λ_n > 0 (corpus face: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ (taylorCoeff riemannXi n).re, via li_criterion_rh_iff ⟺ RiemannHypothesis); equivalently W(f⋆f̃) ≥ 0 for every admissible test function / every support-L window as L → ∞. A finite-face-plus-infinite-quantifier structure: every finite face is certifiable, the quantifier is RH.
wall.why_finite_fails: Four independent reasons, three literature + one in-house. (1) Freitas Cor 4.2 delocalization: a single off-line zero forces infinitely many negative λ_n, but the first negativity is pushable arbitrarily far out in n — no finite prefix, however long, certifies anything (and by the B1 cost model, certified prefixes are already morally forced by on-line zero verification, so they are not even evidence). (2) The Bombieri–Lagarias identity holds for ARBITRARY multisets symmetric about Re=1/2 — finite positivity faces are algebra, carrying zero arithmetic content about ζ specifically. (3) Quantitative collapse: window positivity per fixed L reduces to one finite PSD check, but λ_min(L) decays at the Landau–Widom rate and certification cost is doubly exponential in L (Zhu 2026); the totally-positive tail budget B_T (Groskin 2026) lets certified height buy only ~1 bit per doubling of T, and the band [−B_T, 0) certifies NOTHING — the finite calculus is structurally information-starved exactly where RH lives. (4) House precedent: the naive finite-prime torus ladder was proved FALSE at every rung, Obligation A was kernel-refuted after being scheduled as provable — the program's own history says finite shadows of this wall systematically masquerade as 'merely hard'.
wall.temperedness_relation: This wall IS the growth clause the Selberg dictionary isolates, in different coordinates. QC_TORUS_MEMO §2.1 pins the 'growth/order' row as THE RH-hardness carrier (the R1 temperedness clause of the dual comb — named, isolated, NOT discharged). Voros's dichotomy makes the identification exact on the Li side: RH ⟺ λ_n ∼ n(A log n + B) (TEMPERED growth) vs RH-false ⟺ non-tempered, exponentially growing oscillations injected by off-line zeros. So 'λ_n ≥ 0 for all n' is not merely analogous to temperedness — positivity of the Li sequence, temperedness of its growth, and absence of (1,1)-inertia blocks in compressed Weil forms (Alpöge–Furman Prop 4.1 / Bombieri's inertia link) are three readings of one obstruction: an off-line pair = a non-tempered dual-comb mode = a negative inertia direction = eventually-negative λ_n. Route B's wall and the torus program's undischarged growth clause are the same wall; instruments built here (defect counting, window PSD) are the finite probes of that clause, and conservation of difficulty predicts no probe sequence tunnels through it.

report.assessment: Expected value, honestly: Route B will not prove RH, by structure rather than by difficulty — the corpus's own honesty theorem (RH_CLOSURE_ROUTES_ASSESSMENT §1) applies verbatim, since the route's terminal statement is a two-way equivalence and every finite advance provably reduces RH to a still-infinite tail (li_rh_iff_tail). Decade-scale odds posture: P(this route yields RH) ≈ 0 independent of effort; P(this route yields the field's first kernel-formalized T→∞ explicit formula + BL bridge, a genuinely citable formalization first) I'd put at 60–75% given B5/B6/B7 are hard-known-shape with most analytic ingredients already kernel-clean in this island; P(certified partial positivity meaningfully past Bombieri–Yoshida's 2L ≤ log 2) under 20% — the doubly-exponential Landau–Widom cost and the 'does not extend' verdict on every known partial-uniform theorem are quantitative, not rhetorical. Where the real value sits: (1) FALSIFIABILITY — this is the only route in the program with a genuine one-directional payload (li_neg_refutes_rh, bragg_below_floor_refutes_rh, weilGram negIndex ≥ 1): a single certified negative anywhere validly refutes RH, and the defect instrument now COUNTS violations rather than merely detecting them; (2) CONVERGENCE — B4's defect-zero-on-certified-window makes MIRRORMERE's inertia instruments ride ANDÚRIL's ladder, and the B6/B7 chain would unify the corpus's currently-separate Li and Bragg faces into one formal object; (3) the wall identification itself: Voros's dichotomy plus the Selberg-dictionary growth clause make Li positivity and comb temperedness the SAME undischarged clause, which is exactly the cross-route consistency the Seven-Faces architecture predicts. Conservative classifications applied per house precedent: B9 is open-research (not hard-known-shape) because 'grow L' has no known method and every claimed mechanism should be presumed a wall candidate; the hcomp exhaustion seam stays inside the wall, unscheduled; B7's analytic layer is hard-known-shape (not engineering) because BL's conditional-convergence bookkeeping is precisely the kind of step the house has previously mislabeled. What would change my mind: (a) an unconditional uniform-in-n lower bound on the von-Mangoldt oscillation term in Coffey's split — none exists and its existence is morally RH, so I'd first suspect an error; (b) Connes–Consani-line positivity extending past the single archimedean place to any semi-local case with two finite places — their own abstract says the tools make sense there and that positivity there implies RH, so any such preprint is simultaneously the most exciting and the most suspect object possible and should get the full adversarial-verification treatment before any corpus wiring; (c) a proof that window positivity at some finite L₀ bootstraps to all L — no such principle is known, and finding one would itself be RH-hard news, not a shortcut.
